title: Confusing interface and too expensive
body: I need an app to track dynamic habits like 3 times at week but not on specific days. I was under the assumption that it could be achieved with premium so I payed for at full year as there is no free trial. The functionality is way too complicated and the UI is confusing.
author: hvxdyvdtkbvg

title: Needs account to even open the app
body: I need an account to even open and see the app so i cannot use it unless i create an account. So for me it was a bad experience
author: Theo K.

title: Beautiful- but room for improvement
body: I would love to customise my habit dashboard. Remove share with friends and stuff that I don’t use and maybe add some more visuals (which days do I succeed and which do I fail) & long term comparison.
author: asbj01rn

title: Fine habit tracker
body: Wish they would remove the mood score.

title: Still waiting for the Vers. 11.0 for MacOS ?

title: A great update that only rarely gets updated
body: The devs used to update this frequently and it worked great. But now they barely do and the app is broken, both on iOS and MacOS. First of all, the apps don't sync across devices so there's really no reason to download it on any other devices than your iPhone. Such a shame.
author: Brosendal

title: Stuck on delete account
body: I am not able to delete my account as the app gets stuck when clicking the "delete my account" button
